source_note: Labour Code of the Republic of Armenia ՀՕ-124-Ն (arlis.am redaction 23.12.2022-06.04.2023; owner confirmed current 22 Nov 2026). Quotes and article reading in docs/legal/PRE_REVIEW.md. Lawyer must confirm.
basis: Art. 113(1) lists the grounds on which the employer may terminate (points 1-13); Art. 115(3)(1): the notice states the ground and reason. Official checklist N 5.1 question 20 first asks whether an Art. 113 ground exists.

title.hy: Գործատուի նախաձեռնությամբ լուծման իրավական հիմքը (113-րդ հոդված) նշված չէ
title.ru: Не указано правовое основание увольнения по инициативе работодателя (ст. 113)
title.en: Legal ground for employer termination (Art. 113) not recorded

edge_cases: Data-completeness check: an employer termination with no ground code (and no workforce-reduction flag, which counts as 113(1)(2)).
Codes: 113(1)(1)-(13) and 93(1) for dismissal on probation. Whether the ground is lawful in the case is not judged.
Also makes notice-period checkable (that rule is skipped until the ground is known).
